what: one full run of a corrected candidate (the branch marianos-1.10-next, not released) at R7's measured rate; R7 itself cannot complete on 1.10.0rc6 (OR-22, OR-23)
from: REPROJECTION_after_R7c.json (R7's five slices) and ESTIMATE_1.10.0rc6.json (the pages of a full run)
formula: submissions = ceil(full_run_pages * submissions_so_far / pages_counted); usd = submissions * 0.0015; short = submissions - envelope_room_submissions; hours = full_run_pages * seconds_of_execution / pages_counted / 3600
